title: Vectorize across independent streams rather than time

definition.title: Vectorize across independent streams rather than time
definition.source_excerpt: A native AVX2 benchmark decoded eight independent IMA-ADPCM state machines in SIMD lanes. All 12,000,000 output samples matched the scalar implementation exactly. Best measured time was 21.76 ms scalar versus 10.49 ms AVX2, a 2.07× speedup. This is strong evidence for cross-stream SIMD on this recurrence, not a claim about a complete browser/FFmpeg audio pipeline.

record.reason: Current player produces one selected audio stream, not eight independent IMA state machines. Cross-stream SIMD requires simultaneous independent demand absent from this playback profile; adding dummy streams would create an artificial gain.
record.next_test: Reopen when actual multi-stream workload exists; compare bounded lane batching to optimized scalar streams and reject latency added solely to fill lanes. AVX2 host speed is not Wasm128 speed.
